crossRefs.note: Hear my teaching, my people. Turn your ears to the words of my mouth.
crossRefs.keyword: A.M. 3416. B.C. 588. (Title.) Maschil of Asaph. or, APsalm for Asaph to give instruction

crossRefs.note: Why do you stand far off, Yahweh? Why do you hide yourself in times of trouble?
I will ask God, my rock, “Why have you forgotten me? Why do I go mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?”
Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him, the saving…
But now you rejected us, and brought us to dishonor, and don’t go out with our armies.
God, you have rejected us. You have broken us down. You have been angry. Restore us, again.
Haven’t you, God, rejected us? You don’t go out with our armies, God.
“Will the Lord reject us forever? Will he be favorable no more?
Yahweh says: “If heaven above can be measured, and the foundations of the earth searched out beneath, then I will also…
“Don’t consider what this people has spoken, saying, ‘Has Yahweh cast off the two families which he chose?’ Thus they…
I ask then, did God reject his people? May it never be! For I also am an Israelite, a descendant of Abraham, of the…
God didn’t reject his people, which he foreknew. Or don’t you know what the Scripture says about Elijah? How he pleads…
How long, Yahweh? Will you be angry forever? Will your jealousy burn like fire?
Yahweh will not pardon him, but then Yahweh’s anger and his jealousy will smoke against that man, and all the curse…
So we, your people and sheep of your pasture, will give you thanks forever. We will praise you forever, to all…
for he is our God. We are the people of his pasture, and the sheep in his care. Today, oh that you would hear his voice!
Know that Yahweh, he is God. It is he who has made us, and we are his. We are his people, and the sheep of his pasture.
“Woe to the shepherds who destroy and scatter the sheep of my pasture!” says Yahweh.
“As I live,” says the Lord Yahweh, “surely because my sheep became a prey, and my sheep became food to all the animals…
You my sheep, the sheep of my pasture, are men, and I am your God,’ says the Lord Yahweh.”
Don’t be afraid, little flock, for it is your Father’s good pleasure to give you the Kingdom.
But you don’t believe, because you are not of my sheep, as I told you.

translations.web: God, why have you rejected us forever? Why does your anger smolder against the sheep of your pasture?
translations.bsb: Why have You rejected us forever, O God? Why does Your anger smolder against the sheep of Your pasture?
translations.kjv: O God, why hast thou cast us off for ever? why doth thine anger smoke against the sheep of thy pasture?
translations.asv: O God, why hast thou cast us off for ever? Why doth thine anger smoke against the sheep of thy pasture?
